title: Topic 2: Personal Information - Writing
description: Handwritten task (Mode B): write on paper and upload a photo.
canDoStatement: Give name, age, nationality, phone, email; spell aloud

writingTask.writingPrompt:
THE FIRST PAPER TASK. Student writes BY HAND, photographs or
scans it, and uploads (photo / PDF / DOCX).

TASK: Fill in a registration form by hand.

Instructions shown in app:
  1. Copy this form on paper (or print it).
  2. Fill it in BY HAND with YOUR information.
  3. Take a photo and upload it.

FORM (displayed in app for the student to copy):
  -----------------------------------------
  ENGLISH SCHOOL - REGISTRATION FORM
  First name:  ______________________
  Last name:   ______________________
  Age:         ______________________
  Country:     ______________________
  City:        ______________________
  Phone number:______________________
  Email:       ______________________
  One sentence about you:
  My name is ________ and I am from ________.
  -----------------------------------------

Minimum requirements:
  - All 7 fields filled in by hand
  - Final sentence complete and readable
minimumRequirements: All 7 fields filled in by hand
